story_type: spacecraft recovery rehearsal at sea, capsule towed into a flooded well deck
hook: Before Artemis II flew, the Navy practiced hauling it out of the sea.
narration: Before Artemis II flew, the Navy practiced hauling an Orion capsule out of the ocean.
This test capsule was floating off San Diego on August first, twenty twenty-three.
It was the first recovery test for the crewed Artemis II mission, run with the Navy and Air Force.
Helicopter crews practiced lifting people off a raft in a rescue basket.
Then they flew them back to the ship.
The ship floods its own back end, called a well deck, so boats can tow the capsule right inside.
[short pause] Waves crashed over the sailors on the winch line.
As the water drained, the capsule settled onto its cradle.
outcome: NASA and its Navy and Air Force partners successfully completed the test.
title: Navy rehearses an Artemis II recovery
description:
NASA's Landing and Recovery team and Department of Defense partners completed Underway Recovery Test 10, the first recovery test for the crewed Artemis II mission, off the coast of San Diego on Aug. 1, 2023.
